lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense, semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular nodes arranged in horizontal rows along the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical and horizontal white bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting to form a rectilinear lattice on the mid-lateral body wall.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical gradient from light superior surfaces to shadowed inferior margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots scattered across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish attached to the ventral region and trailing the pectoral fins.
